RESULT [labelnoise]: On COCO-full, precision@100 was 0.71 with X-101 vs 0.22 for a baseline score, and on SYNTHIA-AL it was 0.89. The paper estimates that COCO 2017 has about 5% overlooked, 3% badly located and 0.7% swapped annotations.
US [labelnoise]: This is an off-the-shelf, pip-installable (cleanlab.object_detection) screen that takes the YOLO predictions already produced. Run it with out-of-fold predictions on every new harvested increment before admission, and send the lowest-scoring images to the labeller or human queue. It covers the box-location and missed-box errors that embedding checks miss.

RESULT [attribution]: Average precision for finding mislabeled images: 0.365 vs 0.222 for a per-image-mAP baseline (COCO-bench, Detectron-X101), and 0.502 vs 0.313 on SYNTHIA. It estimates that about 5% of COCO 2017 images have an overlooked box, 3% a badly located box, and 0.7% a swapped class. The paper does not report the mAP gain from retraining after fixes.
US [attribution]: Use this as a data-debugging gate before any increment is trained. Score each harvested or OWLv2-auto-labelled batch with the current base model, and quarantine images with low label quality before they reach training. 'Swapped' is exactly the error type left by the wrong class-id join fixed on 2026-09-21.
